reasons.plausibility: The proposed mechanism aligns with established knowledge on protective oxide scale formation and spallation in high-temperature alloys, though the compositional complexity of high-entropy alloys introduces minor uncertainties.
reasons.testability: Systematically varying oxygen partial pressure and measuring oxide scale evolution, mechanical properties, and failure modes constitutes a clear and decisive test of the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: Identifying optimal gas environments to mitigate catastrophic oxidation provides practical guidance for alloy processing and application, making the hypothesis valuable for ongoing high-entropy alloy research.
